dataset_name: SCAN (Standardized Centralized Alzheimer’s & Related Dementias Neuroimaging)
access_type: Restricted (Free for researchers via the NACC Data Front Door / Quick Access File request; defaced images available since August 2024; raw images stored at LONI)
institution: National Alzheimer's Coordinating Center (NACC, University of Washington), LONI (USC), UC Berkeley/Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, Mayo Clinic, UC Davis, University of Michigan; funded by the National Institute on Aging (NIA)
modality: MRI, PET (MRI: required T1 and FLAIR, optional advanced sequences; Amyloid PET: PiB, florbetapir, florbetaben, NAV4694, flutemetamol; Tau PET: flortaucipir, MK6240, PI2620, GTP1; FDG PET)
acquisition_protocol: Standardized SCAN MRI and PET protocols harmonized across NIA-funded Alzheimer's Disease Research Centers (ADRCs); images uploaded to LONI and QC'd centrally.
preprocessing: Centralized de-identification/defacing and QC; MRI processed with FreeSurfer (Desikan-Killiany regional volumes, cortical thickness, surface area), white matter hyperintensity and infarct quantification; PET processed to regional SUVRs (amyloid, tau, FDG); advanced MRI derivatives (FA, CBF, functional connectivity) when available.
disease: Alzheimer's Disease, Dementia (related dementias), Mild Cognitive Impairment
clinical_data: Yes (through linkage to the NACC Uniform Data Set (UDS), which includes demographics, cognitive testing, clinical ratings, medical history, and more)
histopathology: Yes (For participants who have come to autopsy, SCAN data can be linked to the NACC Neuropathology (NP) Data Set.)
lab_data: Yes (Imaging and biomarker data are available on a subset of UDS participants.)

dataset_name: ADNI (Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative)
access_type: Restricted (Free; requires approved online data use application via LONI IDA)
institution: National Institute on Aging (NIA)
modality: MRI, PET (MRI (T1-weighted, T2-weighted, FLAIR, T2* Gradient Echo, Diffusion Tensor Imaging, Arterial Spin Labeling, task-free resting-state fMRI) and PET (Amyloid and Tau tracers))
resolution: 1.0 mm isotropic (T1 (3T): 1.0mm isotropic; T2 (3T): 0.9x0.9x2mm; FLAIR: 1.0x1.0x5mm; DTI: 2.7mm isotropic; rsfMRI: 3.3mm isotropic; FDG-PET: 2mm isotropic; Amyloid-PET: 2mm isotropic; Tau-PET: 1.5–2.5mm isotropic)
acquisition_protocol: Standardized, multi-phase (ADNI1/GO/2/3) protocols for 1.5T/3T MRI and PET. (MRI protocol includes back-to-back 3D T1-weighted MP-RAGE scans and an axial Proton Density/T2-weighted dual-contrast FSE/TSE scan. Protocols were standardized for 1.5T and 3T scanners from GE, Philips, and Siemens.)
preprocessing: Standardized MRI and PET preprocessing pipelines. (For MRI, early phases involved centralized, offline corrections (Gradwarp, B1, N3), while later phases rely on on-scanner vendor corrections. For PET, a standardized pipeline includes motion correction, averaging, spatial normalization, and resolution harmonization.)
disease: Alzheimer's Disease, Mild Cognitive Impairment, Subjective Cognitive Decline (subjective memory concerns)
clinical_data: Yes (demographics, physical and neurological exams, and neuropsychological test scores)
histopathology: Yes (Neuropathology data, including histopathologic assessments based on NIA-AA guidelines, are available for participants who consented to brain donation.)
lab_data: Yes (It includes biofluid biomarker data from cerebrospinal fluid (CSF), serum, and urine)

dataset_name: BrainLat
access_type: Open (Synapse account and acceptance of data use conditions)
institution: Latin American Brain Health Institute (BrainLat); ReDLat Consortium
modality: MRI, EEG (Anatomical MRI, Resting-state fMRI, DWI, Resting-state EEG)
acquisition_protocol: Anatomical MRI: T1-weighted volumetric magnetization-prepared rapid gradient echo (T1-MPRAGE). preprocessing: For EEG data, a basic pipeline was applied: re-referencing to the average, band-pass filtering (0.5–40 Hz), down-sampling to 512 Hz, and ICA-based artifact correction for eye movements. dataset_name: Australian Imaging, Biomarkers and Lifestyle (AIBL) Study of Ageing
access_type: Restricted (Data access requires approval; subset of imaging available via LONI IDA application)
institution: CSIRO, Edith Cowan University, National Ageing Research Institute, Florey Institute
modality: MRI, PET (PET includes PiB and FDG)
resolution: MRI: Voxel size of 1.0×1.0×1.0 mm for 3D T1-weighted sequences. PET: Not specified.
age_range: >60 years, later expanded to a minimum age of 50 years.
acquisition_protocol: The acquisition protocol for Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) uses several Siemens scanners, including 1.5T Avanto and 3T models like Trio, Skyra, Prisma Fit, and Verio. The main sequence is a 3D T1-weighted MP-RAGE with a repetition time (TR) of 2300 ms, an echo time (TE) of 2.98 or 3.05 ms, and a flip angle of 9 degrees. For Positron Emission Tomography (PET) imaging, several tracers are used to detect Amyloid-beta (Abeta), including 11C-PIB, 18F-Florbetaben, 18F-Florbetapir, 18F-Flutemetamol, and 18F-NAV4694. The protocol for 11C-PIB involves summing frames from the 50 to 70-minute window after injection. For 18F-Florbetapir, three 5-minute frames are acquired starting 50 minutes after injection, and for 18F-Flutemetamol, four 5-minute frames are acquired starting 90 minutes after injection. The study also uses the 18F-MK6240 tracer for Tau PET scans and the 18F-SMBT-1 tracer for MAO-B PET scans; however, the specific acquisition protocols for these, as well as for 18F-Florbetaben and 18F-NAV4694, are Not specified in the available materials.
preprocessing: Conversion to NIFTI, brain extraction, registration to MNI space.
